issues: Document is a landscape-oriented table printed on portrait pages without page rotation flags in the PDF metadata; pages were re-rendered rotated 270 degrees for legibility. No ТР ТС section headings appear anywhere in this scope document, so tr_section is null for all rows. Many rows use compound/qualitative range formats (e.g. presence/absence combined with a CFU range, or scientific-notation CFU ranges like "(1,0-9,9)*10^n КОЕ") that do not fit the simple numeric range pattern; for these the full range text was kept in range_from with range_to/unit left null, per the non-numeric-range rule. Item 28 (ГОСТ 31986-2012) is a nested table of 12 sub-clauses (Приложение А, п.А.1-А.12), each covering one food category with several organoleptic indicators (each scored (2-5) баллов); these were expanded into one JSON row per indicator per the row-splitting rule. Items 4, 6, 9, 17, 28, 36, 38 print only a continuation reference (e.g. "приложение 3", "п.10.1.4") rather than repeating the full document name; norm_doc for these rows is transcribed exactly as printed rather than inferred/expanded.
